fact: Togo's Office Togolais des Recettes says transit declarations from Lome to Bingo Burkina are registered on Togo's Sydonia World since 11 May 2018.
L'Economiste du Faso reports Burkina Faso customs launched Sydonia World online on 13 November 2019, after use at pilot sites since 2 February 2015.

The Direction generale des douanes and SOGESY launched Sylvie 2 on 17 February 2025, the electronic single window for import and export clearance, running since 2016 and collecting documents from technical administrations and private bodies.
Sylvie 2 improves interfacing with SYDONIA, the automated customs system, and facilitates customs clearance operations, per the customs director general.
